exposure: Alalfy modified cervical inversion technique plus hemostatic sutures
no cervical inversion and only hemostatic sutures
cohort: 240 pregnant women with placenta previa undergoing planned cesarean section
finding: The addition of modified cervical inversion (Alalfy technique) to hemostatic sutures in women with placenta previa undergoing cesarean section significantly reduced intraoperative blood loss, operative time, and improved postoperative hemoglobin levels.
mod_finding: The study found that cervical inversion, when added to hemostatic sutures, was effective in reducing blood loss and operative time in cases of placenta previa.
